set.rappels: Usually none: the standard descent downclimbs the Class 3-4 rock near the col. One documented party rappelled the exposed step instead, making three rappels from natural anchors on a 60 m rope
set.rappel_count_note: Most parties downclimb the technical section near the Lemah Two-Main col. One documented descent rappelled it instead: three rappels from slings on horns and chockstones with a 60 m rope, to a small ledge from which the rest was downclimbed. Station positions are not published, so none are listed.
